claims.claim: Jim writes at the request of Squire Trelawney and Dr. Livesey
Jim's father kept the Admiral Benbow inn; brown old seaman with sabre cut lodged
Billy Bones dies at the Admiral Benbow
claims.evidence: 'struck dead by thundering apoplexy'; doctor: 'you have had a stroke'

claims.claim: Jim takes Bones's map of Captain Flint's treasure from his chest
claims.evidence: 'picking up the oilskin packet'; 'the map of an island'; Flint's treasure per Livesey

claims.claim: Trelawney and Livesey fit out the Hispaniola
claims.evidence: Trelawney: 'The ship is bought and fitted ... name, Hispaniola.'
'Captain Smollett, sir, axing to speak with you'

claims.claim: Silver is a one-legged cook who leads the mutiny
Jim overhears the mutiny plan from an apple barrel

claims.evidence: 'Narrative Resumed by Jim Hawkins: The Garrison in the Stockade'
'both my pistols went off ... Hands ... was dead enough, being both shot and drowned'

claims.claim: Ben Gunn, a marooned man, had already moved the treasure
claims.evidence: 'he had dug it up ... carried it ... to a cave he had on the two-pointed hill'

claims.claim: They sail home with the treasure
claims.evidence: 'we made a good cruise home, and the Hispaniola reached Bristol'
'Silver was gone ... escape in a shore boat'

claims.claim: Silver takes a bag of coins
claims.evidence: 'removed one of the sacks of coin, worth perhaps three or four hundred guineas' (a sack, not a bag; sentence also duplicated)
claims.fix: Silver slips away with a sack of coin

claims.claim: The rest is shared among the survivors
claims.evidence: 'Five men only ... returned'; 'All of us had an ample share of the treasure'
'Oxen and wain-ropes would not bring me back again to that accursed island'

claims.claim: Billy Bones is an old buccaneer at the inn; Gunn marooned former pirate
Livesey is a doctor and magistrate
